scenario_sampling.method: NumPy default_rng(seed).choice(sorted accepted IDs, 100, replace=False); execute sorted IDs

protocol.temporal_resolution: 13 selected delays; 0.04 s through 0.20, then gaps up to 0.40 s; tested thresholds are coarse bounds
protocol.beyond_prediction_horizon: Unchanged gate: ready finite expiry rejects; no predicted expiry permits dispatch; unavailable forecast permits dispatch
protocol.completion_observation: Fixed 8 s after approval; inspection not observed by deadline is incomplete, not proof of impossibility later
protocol.primary_recovery: Existing Eastward sideways maneuver only; no climb selection

fbs.feature: required clearance minus minimum actual 3D body clearance; EMA through approval inclusive

protocol.readiness: Measured warmed runtime replayed on the control clock; unavailable approval forecasts fail open
protocol.ordering: Approval first; readiness; dispatch; pending timers; maneuver start; physical ticks. Dispatch wins timer ties.
protocol.use_time_recheck: One immediate-command rollout from actual dispatch state; act at dispatch + floor(runtime*50)+1
protocol.unknown_delay: Only the physical driver knows scheduled dispatch. Policies receive the event when it occurs.

startup_warmups.description: Platform load; shared PID/RK4 and checker kernel warmup; no full forecast
